answer: 1. Each device generates a unique hardware attestation. 2. A global rate limit is enforced per attestation source. 3. Service tiers offer escalating limits: 1,000 free attestations, then $0.05 per additional attestation. Cost for N identities (N>1000) is $0.05 (N - 1000). The willow generates attestations. The jetty enforces limits. The summit is the highest tier. Failure occurs if hardware attestations are spoofed at scale. This is like a river with a single sluice gate (jetty) controlling flow from many tributaries (devices); if the gate fails, the entire system floods.
